find_package(Doxygen)

if(NOT DOXYGEN_FOUND)
    message(WARNING "Doxygen not found; documentation target will be unavailable")
    return()
endif()

set(DOXYGEN_INPUT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
set(DOXYGEN_OUTPUT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/doxygen")

set(DOXYGEN_PROJECT_NAME "ExolangTk")
set(DOXYGEN_PROJECT_BRIEF "C99 Header-Only Toolkit for Compiler and Interpreter Interoperability")
set(DOXYGEN_PROJECT_NUMBER "${PROJECT_VERSION}")
set(DOXYGEN_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${DOXYGEN_OUTPUT_DIR}")
set(DOXYGEN_INPUT "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
set(DOXYGEN_FILE_PATTERNS "*.h")
set(DOXYGEN_RECURSIVE YES)
set(DOXYGEN_EXTRACT_ALL YES)
set(DOXYGEN_EXTRACT_STATIC YES)
set(DOXYGEN_EXTRACT_PRIVATE NO)
set(DOXYGEN_SOURCE_BROWSER YES)
set(DOXYGEN_INLINE_SOURCES NO)
set(DOXYGEN_REFERENCED_BY_RELATION YES)
set(DOXYGEN_REFERENCES_RELATION YES)
set(DOXYGEN_HTML_OUTPUT "html")
set(DOXYGEN_GENERATE_HTML YES)
set(DOXYGEN_GENERATE_LATEX YES)
set(DOXYGEN_LATEX_OUTPUT "latex")
set(DOXYGEN_GENERATE_MAN YES)
set(DOXYGEN_MAN_OUTPUT "man")
set(DOXYGEN_MAN_LINKS YES)
set(DOXYGEN_GENERATE_TREEVIEW YES)
set(DOXYGEN_DISABLE_INDEX NO)
set(DOXYGEN_FULL_SIDEBAR NO)
set(DOXYGEN_USE_MDFILE_AS_MAINPAGE "${DOXYGEN_INPUT_DIR}/FrontPage.md")
set(DOXYGEN_LAYOUT_FILE "${DOXYGEN_INPUT_DIR}/layout.xml")
set(DOXYGEN_STRIP_FROM_PATH "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
set(DOXYGEN_STRIP_FROM_INC_PATH "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
set(DOXYGEN_CASE_SENSE_NAMES YES)
set(DOXYGEN_SORT_MEMBER_DOCS YES)
set(DOXYGEN_SORT_BRIEF_DOCS YES)
set(DOXYGEN_QUIET YES)
set(DOXYGEN_WARN_IF_UNDOCUMENTED NO)
set(DOXYGEN_WARN_IF_DOC_ERROR YES)
set(DOXYGEN_WARN_NO_PARAMDOC YES)
set(DOXYGEN_MACRO_EXPANSION YES)
set(DOXYGEN_EXPAND_ONLY_PREDEF YES)
set(DOXYGEN_PREDEFINED
    "ITK_DEF=static"
    "FFI_DEF=static"
    "DTK_DEF=static"
    "ETK_DEF=static"
    "ITK_DEFINED=1"
    "FFI_DEFINED=1"
    "DTK_DEFINED=1"
    "ETK_DEFINED=1"
)
set(DOXYGEN_EXPAND_AS_DEFINED
    "ITK_DEF"
    "FFI_DEF"
    "DTK_DEF"
    "ETK_DEF"
)
set(DOXYGEN_OPTIMIZE_OUTPUT_FOR_C YES)
set(DOXYGEN_TOC_INCLUDE_HEADINGS 3)
set(DOXYGEN_MARKDOWN_SUPPORT YES)
set(DOXYGEN_AUTOLINK_SUPPORT YES)
set(DOXYGEN_BUILTIN_STL_SUPPORT NO)
set(DOXYGEN_CPP_CLI_SUPPORT NO)
set(DOXYGEN_SIP_SUPPORT NO)
set(DOXYGEN_IDL_PROPERTY_SUPPORT NO)
set(DOXYGEN_DISTRIBUTE_GROUP_DOC NO)
set(DOXYGEN_GROUP_NESTED_COMPOUNDS NO)
set(DOXYGEN_SUBGROUPING YES)
set(DOXYGEN_INLINE_GROUPED_CLASSES NO)
set(DOXYGEN_INLINE_SIMPLE_STRUCTS NO)
set(DOXYGEN_TYPEDEF_HIDES_STRUCT NO)
set(DOXYGEN_LOOKUP_CACHE_SIZE 0)
set(DOXYGEN_EXTRACT_LOCAL_CLASSES YES)
set(DOXYGEN_EXTRACT_LOCAL_METHODS NO)
set(DOXYGEN_EXTRACT_ANON_NSPACES NO)
set(DOXYGEN_HIDE_UNDOC_MEMBERS NO)
set(DOXYGEN_HIDE_UNDOC_CLASSES NO)
set(DOXYGEN_HIDE_FRIEND_COMPOUNDS NO)
set(DOXYGEN_HIDE_IN_BODY_DOCS NO)
set(DOXYGEN_INTERNAL_DOCS NO)
set(DOXYGEN_SHOW_USED_FILES YES)
set(DOXYGEN_SHOW_FILES YES)
set(DOXYGEN_SHOW_NAMESPACES NO)
set(DOXYGEN_VERBATIM_HEADERS YES)

doxygen_add_docs(exolangtk-docs
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
    "${DOXYGEN_INPUT_DIR}/FrontPage.md"
    "${DOXYGEN_INPUT_DIR}/manual"
    COMMENT "Generate ExolangTk API documentation"
)
